import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}"
path = "unpacked/word/document.xml"

data = open(path, "rb").read()
doc = data.decode("ascii")

root = ET.fromstring(data)

# Headline paragraphs: all-caps section titles (no lowercase, no bullets/dashes,
# at least one letter; digits/spaces/plain punctuation allowed for e.g. "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK")
headline_re = re.compile(r"^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9 &%.,()/'-]*$")


def para_text(p):
    return "".join(t.text or "" for t in p.iter(W + "t"))


headlines = []
for p in root.iter(W + "p"):
    t = para_text(p).strip()
    if (
        t
        and not any(c.islower() for c in t)
        and headline_re.match(t)
        and re.search(r"[A-Z]", t)
    ):
        headlines.append((p, t))

expected = {
    "EXECUTIVE SUMMARY",
    "FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS",
    "REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT",
    "KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS",
    "OPERATING EXPENSES",
    "Q1 2025 OUTLOOK",
    "RISK FACTORS",
}
found = sorted(set(t for _, t in headlines))
assert found == sorted(expected), (found, sorted(expected))
assert len(headlines) == len(expected), len(headlines)

# Surgical insertion: for each headline run, add <w:u w:val="single"/> right after
# its <w:sz-cs w:val="24"/> run property (schema-valid position before </w:rPr>).
inserted = 0
for _, t in headlines:
    needle = "<w:t xml:space=\"preserve\">%s</w:t>" % t
    pos = doc.find(needle)
    assert pos != -1, t
    assert doc.count(needle) == 1, t
    sz = doc.rfind("<w:sz-cs w:val=\"24\"/>", 0, pos)
    assert sz != -1, t
    end = sz + len("<w:sz-cs w:val=\"24\"/>")
    assert doc[end:end + 5] == "</w:r", t  # sz-cs belongs to this run's rPr
    doc = doc[:end] + "<w:u w:val=\"single\"/>" + doc[end:]
    inserted += 1

assert inserted == 7

# Validate: file still parses and every headline paragraph run now carries underline
root2 = ET.fromstring(doc.encode("ascii"))
underlined = [e for e in root2.iter(W + "u") if e.get(W + "val") == "single"]
assert len(underlined) == 7, len(underlined)
for _, t in headlines:
    para_runs = []
    for p2 in root2.iter(W + "p"):
        if para_text(p2).strip() == t:
            para_runs = [r for r in p2 if r.tag == W + "r"]
            break
    assert para_runs, t
    assert all(
        r.find(W + "rPr/" + W + "u") is not None
        and r.find(W + "rPr/" + W + "u").get(W + "val") == "single"
        for r in para_runs
    ), t

open(path, "wb").write(doc.encode("ascii"))
print("Underlined %d headlines: %s" % (inserted, ", ".join(sorted(expected))))
